1054.description: Lunge forward with the back leg straight to stretch the calf. It improves ankle mobility.
instructions: Step into a lunge with hands on a wall or knee.
Keep the back leg straight with heel down.
Lean forward until you feel a stretch.
Keep your foot pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1182.description: An easier push-up variation from the knees that builds chest, shoulder and arm strength.
instructions: Kneel on the floor with your hands slightly wider than shoulder width.
Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.

1246.description: A gymnastics-style hold with your shoulders and legs lifted. It builds deep core strength.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and legs a few inches off the ground.
Hold the shape and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

1310.description: A weighted push-up variation where you drop and shift your hands between push-ups for extra load. It challenges the chest and triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Lower your chest towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Once your chest is just above the ground, explosively push yourself up, lifting your hands off the ground.
As you push up, quickly move your hands out to the sides and slightly forward, allowing your body to drop down towards the ground.
Catch yourself with your hands in the wider position and immediately lower your chest towards the ground again.
Repeat the push-up motion, dropping down and catching yourself with your hands in the narrower position.
Continue alternating between the wider and narrower hand positions for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
将胸部压向地面，保持肘部靠近身体。
一旦你的胸部刚好高于地面，爆发性地把自己推起来，将双手抬离地面。
当你向上推时，快速将双手移至两侧并稍微向前，让你的身体向地面落下。
将双手置于更宽的位置，然后立即再次将胸部降低到地面。
重复俯卧撑动作，下降并用双手抓住自己在较窄的位置。
继续在更宽和更窄的手位置之间交替，以达到所需的重复次数。

1374.description: Step off a box and land on both feet, then hold the landing on one leg. It builds landing control and strengthens the calves and ankle.
instructions: Stand in front of a box or platform with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and jump onto the box, landing softly with one foot on the box and the other foot hanging off the edge.
Stabilize yourself on the box with the foot that is on it, while keeping the other foot off the ground.
Hold this position for a few seconds, engaging your calf muscles to maintain balance.
Slowly step down with the foot that is on the box, returning to the starting position.
Repeat the exercise with the other leg.
instructionsZh: 站在盒子或平台前，双脚分开与肩同宽。
弯曲膝盖，跳到盒子上，一只脚轻轻落地，另一只脚悬在盒子边缘。
将脚踩在盒子上，将自己稳定在盒子上，同时保持另一只脚离开地面。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，锻炼小腿肌肉以保持平衡。
将放在盒子上的脚慢慢放下，回到起始位置。
用另一条腿重复该练习。

1438.description: A seated overhead press with a kettlebell in each hand. It trains the shoulders and triceps while the seat keeps your legs out of the lift.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Press the kettlebells overhead by extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the kettlebells back to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
每只手握住一个壶铃，与肩同高，手掌朝前。
完全伸展双臂，将壶铃压过头顶。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将壶铃放回肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。

1502.description: A band version of the triceps pushdown that isolates the back of the arm.
instructions: Anchor the band high and hold the ends with your elbows at your sides.
Stand tall with a slight forward lean.
Push your hands down until your arms are straight.
Pause and squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly while keeping your elbows pinned to your sides.

1566.description: A squat while holding a kettlebell locked out overhead with one arm. It trains leg strength together with shoulder stability and core control.
instructions: Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm and lock out your elbow.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and keep your ribs down.
Squat down with your chest up while keeping the bell stable over your shoulder.
Go as low as you can with good control.
Drive up through your heels, then switch arms after your reps.

1630.description: A cable curl with a close grip. It keeps constant tension on the biceps.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley cable machine.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Exhale and curl the bar up towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the bar back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将直杆连接到低滑轮电缆机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
反手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
在整个练习过程中，保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气并将杠铃向上卷向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1694.description: A side lunge with a dumbbell held overhead that trains the legs and core stability.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands or one hand and stand tall.
Step out wide to one side and sit back into the hips.
Keep your chest tall and your arm locked out overhead.
Push through the bent leg to return to the middle.
Alternate sides for the planned reps.

1758.description: A sit-up with your feet held down by a partner or anchor. Trains the abs through a full curling motion.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench or have someone hold your feet down.
Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳边缘或让某人按住你的脚。
平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1822.description: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist extensors with ulnar deviation, easing tightness after gripping or typing.
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point down.
Gently tilt the hand toward the little finger side.
Use the other hand to apply light pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

1886.description: Lets one heel drop off a step to stretch the Achilles and calf.
instructions: Stand on a step with the ball of one foot on the edge.
Hold a rail for balance.
Lower your heel slowly below the step.
Keep the knee straight for the calf, then slightly bent for the soleus.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

2142.description: Pulling the handles of a ski ergometer down in a rhythmic stroke. Works the arms, back and core while raising your heart rate.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footrests to a comfortable position.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Sit up straight with your feet flat on the footrests.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Engage your triceps and push the handles down towards your thighs.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将座椅高度和脚踏板调整到舒适的位置。
正手握住手柄，手掌朝下。
坐直，双脚平放在脚踏板上。
将手臂伸直在身前，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
收紧三头肌并将手柄向下推向大腿。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2206.description: A reverse crunch where you roll a roller toward you with your feet. Trains the lower abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended straight above your head and your legs straight out in front of you.
Place the roller between your feet and grip it with your toes.
Engaging your abs, lift your legs off the ground and curl your knees towards your chest, rolling the roller towards your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position, rolling the roller away from your body.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双臂伸直过头顶，双腿伸直在身前。
将滚筒放在双脚之间，并用脚趾抓住它。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，将膝盖向胸部弯曲，将滚轮向身体方向滚动。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置，将滚轮滚离身体。
重复所需的重复次数。

2334.description: A calf press on a sled machine while lying back. Builds the calf muscles.
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the platform.
Place your toes and the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform, with your heels hanging off.
Push the platform away from you by extending your ankles, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Continue pushing until your calves are fully contracted.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower the platform back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将雪橇机调整至舒适的重量。
坐在雪橇机上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚放在平台上。
将脚趾和脚掌放在平台边缘，脚跟悬空。
伸展脚踝，将平台推离您，保持膝盖稍微弯曲。
继续用力，直到小腿完全收缩。
保持收缩一会儿，然后慢慢将平台放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2398.description: A close-grip push-up done on your knees. An easier way to train the triceps and chest.
instructions: Start by getting on your hands and knees, with your hands shoulder-width apart and your knees hip-width apart.
Lower your upper body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Pause for a moment when your chest is just above the ground.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先双手和膝盖着地，双手与肩同宽，膝盖与臀部同宽。
弯曲肘部，将上身压向地面，使其靠近身体两侧。
当你的胸部刚好高于地面时，暂停片刻。
推动手掌以伸直手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2462.description: A chest dip on a bar, leaning forward and crossing your ankles. Targets the chest and triceps.
instructions: Grab the parallel bars with your palms facing down and your arms fully extended.
Bend your knees and cross your ankles.
Lower your body by bending your arms until your shoulders are below your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 手掌朝下，双臂完全伸展，抓住双杠。
弯曲膝盖并交叉脚踝。
弯曲手臂，降低身体，直到肩膀低于肘部。
伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2526.description: A plank held on a vibrating platform that adds challenge to your core.
instructions: Place your forearms or hands on the vibrating plate.
Extend your legs behind you.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.
Come down carefully.

2718.description: Holding a load out in front of your body, building shoulder and core endurance.
instructions: Pick up the weights and stand tall.
Raise your arms forward to shoulder height.
Hold with a braced core.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid leaning back.
Hold as long as you can, then lower with control.

2782.description: Moving the arm forward and across the body in a horizontal arc, working the chest.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with one arm held out to the side at shoulder height.
Sweep the arm forward and across your body in a horizontal arc.
Keep the arm at shoulder height, pause, then return.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2846.description: The classic Pilates warm-up where you pump your arms while holding your legs up, building abdominal endurance.
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your head and shoulders.
Raise your legs to a tabletop or extend them.
Pump your arms up and down in small beats.
Breathe in for five beats and out for five.
Aim for one hundred beats.

2910.description: Carrying one heavy dumbbell at your side like a suitcase. It challenges your grip and forces your trunk to resist leaning.
instructions: Pick up one dumbbell with a tall, braced posture and hold it at your side.
Keep your shoulders level and your ribs stacked over your hips.
Walk with steady steps without leaning toward the weight.
Cover the set distance, then put the weight down safely.
Switch hands and repeat.

2974.description: A single-arm chest press on a plate-loaded machine. It lets each side work on its own.
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and grip one handle.
Set your feet flat on the floor.
Press the handle forward until your arm is nearly straight.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.

3102.description: A plate-loaded machine row with a narrow grip for the lats and mid back.
instructions: Sit with your chest against the pad and take the narrow handles.
Pull both handles toward your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly with control.

3166.description: A standing, bent-over row pulling a bar or handles toward your body with an overhand grip. It builds the upper back and the muscles that retract the shoulder blades.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Grasp a bar or handles with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Pull the bar or handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement.
Slowly release and extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杆或手柄，手掌朝下。
保持背部挺直，核心参与。
将杠铃或手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻。
慢慢释放并伸展双臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3230.description: A face-down hold with your hands clasped behind you. It trains the back extensors and opens the chest.
instructions: Lie face down with your hands clasped behind your lower back.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Reach your hands toward your feet.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.

3294.description: A wide push-up that shifts the weight to one arm while the other arm stays straight. It trains the chest and triceps on the way to one arm push-ups.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm straight out to the side, parallel to the ground.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, extending the opposite arm out to the side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
将一只手臂伸直至一侧，与地面平行。
弯曲肘部降低身体，保持背部挺直，核心参与。
推回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复上述步骤，将另一只手臂伸出到一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3358.description: A lat pulldown done from the floor with a neutral grip, focusing on the lats.
instructions: Kneel or sit on the floor under a high cable with a parallel grip handle.
Sit tall and lean back slightly.
Pull the handle down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and back.
Return slowly to full arm extension.

3422.description: A crunch holding a medicine ball to add resistance for the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a medicine ball on your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chin off your chest.
Breathe out as you crunch up.

3486.description: An underhand-grip hang under a bar between two chairs, curling your body up with the biceps. Bent knees keep it manageable.
instructions: Place a sturdy bar across two stable chairs and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar underhand, arms straight, knees bent.
Keep your hips up and body in a line.
Curl yourself up by bending the elbows, keeping them close.
Lower with control until the arms are straight.
Check the chairs are stable before each set.

3550.description: A seated pull-up using a bar between two chairs, with the legs assisting.
instructions: Set a bar across two sturdy chairs.
Sit on the floor beneath it and grip the bar.
Keep your legs bent for light help.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower with control.
Use your legs as little as possible.

3678.description: Jump rope with higher jumps to add power and intensity.
instructions: Hold the rope handles and stand tall.
Swing the rope overhead.
Jump higher than usual.
Land softly with bent knees.
Keep your rhythm.

3742.description: A bodyweight hamstring curl where your heels slide on a towel across the floor.
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips off the ground.
Slide your heels toward your butt, curling your legs.
Slowly slide them back out.
Keep your hips high throughout.

3870.description: A reverse hyperextension with the legs in a frog position, aimed at the glutes and lower back.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and hold the bench for support.
Let your legs hang and bring the soles of your feet together, knees out.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs up behind you.
Pause when your thighs are in line with your torso.
Lower slowly and repeat.
Avoid arching your lower back too far.

4062.description: Chest-supported T bar row on a lever machine with bands for extra resistance as you pull.
instructions: Lie chest down on the support and grip the handles.
Keep your head neutral.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly against the band tension.

4126.description: A row starting from the rack pins, resetting every rep for strict pulling.
instructions: Set the bar on pins at knee height.
Hinge forward and grip the bar.
Row it to your lower ribs.
Lower it back to the pins and pause.
Reset your back before the next rep.

4190.description: Move the EZ bar in an arc with a twist. It trains the obliques.
instructions: Stand holding the EZ bar in front of you.
Raise it overhead.
Lower it diagonally across your body, twisting.
Return overhead.
Alternate sides.
Move with control.

4254.description: A vertical jump from one leg to build explosive power and balance. Each side gets its own work.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Swing your arms back.
Jump straight up as high as you can.
Land softly on the same leg.
Reset your balance.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

4318.description: A pullover lying on the floor, which limits the stretch range and keeps the focus on the lats and chest.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the weight in an arc behind your head until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.
Keep your ribs down and core tight throughout.

4382.description: A forward lunge with the bar resting on your front shoulders. The front load works the quads and glutes and challenges your core.
instructions: Rest the barbell on the front of your shoulders with elbows high.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs, keeping your torso upright.

4446.description: A one-arm overhead press with the kettlebell held upside down from a half-kneeling stance. Challenges shoulder stability, grip and core.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the opposite foot flat in front, back upright.
Hold a kettlebell by the handle with the bell pointing up, at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle tight and brace your core.
Press straight overhead while keeping the bell balanced.
Lower under control back to the shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

4510.description: A standing wall stretch for the calf muscles. Helps with ankle mobility and tight lower legs.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it.
Step one foot back with the heel on the floor.
Bend your front knee and lean forward.
Feel the stretch in the back calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

4574.description: A compound arm move that links a biceps curl into an overhead press.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl both dumbbells up to your shoulders.
Rotate your palms to face forward at the top of the curl.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders, then down to your sides.
Keep your core tight and avoid swinging.

4702.description: A face-down lift of opposite arm and leg to strengthen the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg together.
Hold for a second.
Lower and switch to the other side.
Keep your neck neutral and move with control.

4766.description: Hanging from a bar, you alternate small, fast kicks with straight legs. It trains the lower abs and grip.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms straight.
Tighten your core and lift your legs slightly in front of you.
Kick your legs up and down in alternating small movements.
Keep your swing minimal.
Continue for the set time or reps.

4830.description: A push-up performed from a kneeling child's pose position. It trains the chest and triceps with a gentle range.
instructions: Kneel and sit back on your heels with your arms stretched forward.
Place your hands on the floor at chest height.
Shift forward and lower your chest between your hands.
Push the floor away to rise.
Sit back to the starting pose and repeat.

4894.description: A side plank with the feet placed one in front of the other for a different base. It trains the obliques and hips.
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder.
Stagger your feet, top foot in front of the bottom one.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Keep the hips high and avoid rolling forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

4958.description: A one arm overhead triceps extension with a rope. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Hold a rope with one hand overhead and face away from the stack.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Extend your elbow until the arm is straight.
Squeeze the triceps.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

5214.description: Cycling outdoors at an easy to moderate pace. It is a low-impact way to build endurance.
instructions: Adjust your saddle so your leg is almost straight at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Wear a helmet and check your brakes.
Start at an easy pace to warm up.
Pedal smoothly at a steady, comfortable rhythm for 20-60 minutes.
Cool down with a few minutes of easy pedalling.

5278.description: A push-up from your knees with hands set at staggered heights. It builds the chest in a more manageable way.
instructions: Kneel and place your hands on the floor, one slightly forward of the other.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Switch hand positions on the next set.

5406.description: Combines a side bend with a forward fold while holding a stick overhead. Stretches the side body, lower back and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold the stick overhead.
Bend sideways to one side and hold briefly.
Then turn the torso forward and fold from your hips with a long back.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, then rise slowly.
Repeat on the other side.

5470.description: Standing cable kickback angled out to the side that targets the upper glutes (gluteus medius) and hip stability.
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and clip it to one ankle.
Stand side-on to the stack, hold the frame and keep your torso tall.
Sweep the working leg out and slightly back, leading with the heel.
Pause briefly, then return slowly without leaning.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

5598.description: Combo of an inchworm walk-out followed by mountain climbers for a full-body workout.
instructions: Stand tall, then hinge forward and walk your hands out to a plank.
Brace your core and keep a straight line.
Drive your knees to your chest alternately for several reps.
Walk your hands back to your feet.
Stand up and repeat.

5662.description: Explosive shrug with a barbell, using a hip drive to build the traps.
instructions: Hold a barbell at mid-thigh.
Dip your knees slightly.
Extend your hips and shrug explosively.
Lower the bar under control.
Keep your arms straight.

5854.description: A standing calf raise holding a kettlebell for resistance. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the balls of your feet on a step if you like.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Rise as high as you can on your toes.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly.

5982.description: A shortened sun salutation that keeps the upright flow. Gently warms the spine and legs.
instructions: Stand in mountain pose and sweep your arms overhead.
Fold forward with a long spine.
Lift halfway up with a flat back.
Fold again and rise up with your arms overhead.
Lower your hands to your heart and repeat.

6046.description: A stationary lunge holding bottles at your sides. It builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and step into a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

6302.description: A supported deep backbend resting on your forearms. It stretches the chest and spine.
instructions: Start in a headstand or lie on your back with elbows on the floor.
Arch your back and bring your feet toward the floor.
Keep your forearms firm.
Stay in the backbend, breathing steadily.
Hold briefly, then come out carefully.

6366.description: Holding dumbbells behind your body, you curl your wrists to train your forearms and grip.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand behind your back, palms facing back.
Keep your arms still and your chest tall.
Curl your wrists upward.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

6558.description: A wall sit with a band around the knees and a dumbbell held in your lap, adding glute work to the hold.
instructions: Put a band around your thighs and stand with your back against a wall.
Slide down until your thighs are about parallel.
Hold a dumbbell in both hands in front of you.
Push your knees out against the band.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.

6750.description: A one-leg balance with controlled hip rotation. It works hip mobility and stability together.
instructions: Stand tall on one leg with a soft knee, holding a wall if needed.
Lift the other knee to hip height.
Rotate the lifted knee out to the side, then back to the front.
Keep your torso steady.
Move slowly and smoothly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

6878.description: A calm cross-legged seat that opens the hips and teaches you to sit tall.
instructions: Sit on the floor and bend your knees.
Place one heel against your inner thigh and the other foot in front of it.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Relax your shoulders and look straight ahead.
Hold for 30-60 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch the cross of your legs and repeat.

7198.description: A glute bridge with a band around the knees, pressing out to light up the side glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the band just above your knees.
Press through your heels to lift your hips.
At the top, push your knees apart against the band.
Bring the knees back together.
Lower your hips slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

7326.description: Reverse lunge with the front foot raised for a deeper range, hitting the glutes and quads.
instructions: Stand with your front foot on a low platform, holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front knee steady.
Push through the front heel to return.
Finish reps and switch legs.

7582.description: Reverse lunge with the kettlebell on the same side as the working leg.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Step back with the leg on the same side.
Lower under control.
Keep your torso upright.
Push back up and switch sides.

8222.description: A renegade row with an underhand grip on the dumbbells. It builds core stability and works the lats and biceps.
instructions: Set up in a plank with your hands on dumbbells, palms facing forward.
Widen your feet for balance.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Lower and alternate arms.

8798.description: A chest-supported barbell row lying on a raised bench or rack, removing the lower back from the lift.
instructions: Lie face down on a raised bench so the bar hangs below you.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Row the bar up toward your chest by pulling elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

8990.description: Seated sideways on a machine, you pull one arm back in a wide arc. It isolates the rear delt.
instructions: Sit sideways on the machine with your chest against the pad.
Grab the handle with the outside hand.
Start with your arm in front of you and a soft bend in your elbow.
Pull the handle out and back until your arm is in line with your shoulder.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

9246.description: In a wide stance you rotate your upper back to loosen the thoracic spine. It helps with trunk twisting.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide and your knees slightly bent.
Hinge slightly forward with your hands behind your head.
Rotate your chest to one side as far as you can.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Return to the center.
Rotate to the other side and repeat.

9310.description: A standing calf raise held at the top. It builds calf endurance.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Hold the top position for 20 to 30 seconds.
Keep your ankles straight and stable.
Lower your heels slowly.
Rest briefly between holds.

9694.description: An overhead press from a half-kneeling stance, which demands core and hip stability.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a barbell at your shoulder.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your core.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower under control to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

10014.description: Squeeze a ball between your knees while lying on your back. It targets the inner thighs.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a ball between your knees.
Rest your arms by your sides and keep your lower back relaxed.
Squeeze the ball with your inner thighs.
Hold for a moment, then release slowly.
Keep your hips level throughout.

10462.description: A gentle seated stretch for the back of the thigh, done on a chair. It helps loosen tight hamstrings.
instructions: Sit near the front edge of a chair.
Extend one leg straight with your heel on the floor and toes up.
Hinge forward from your hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Switch legs and repeat.

10590.description: Walk your hands out and sit your hips back to stretch the lats. It opens the sides of the back.
instructions: Stand and hinge forward to place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands out in front of you.
Sit your hips back and press your chest down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Walk your hands back in and stand up.

10654.description: Straighten your knees on a reformer with feet on toes. It trains the front thighs.
instructions: Lie on the carriage with feet on the bar, on your toes.
Bend your knees with a neutral spine.
Press the carriage away until legs straighten.
Return under control.
Keep your hips still.

10910.description: A seated ankle move that sweeps the foot from side to side. It improves ankle mobility.
instructions: Sit tall and lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your lower leg still.
Turn your foot inward, then outward, in a smooth motion.
Move through a comfortable range.
Repeat for your reps, then switch feet.

0030.description: A bench press with a narrower grip that shifts more of the work to the triceps while still working the chest.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the barbell with a close grip, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
紧紧握住杠铃，握距略窄于肩宽。
松开杠铃并将其缓慢降低至胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0094.description: A seated torso twist with the bar on your back. Works the obliques and abs.
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent.
Hold a barbell with both hands in front of your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Engage your core and slowly twist your torso to one side, keeping your back straight.
Pause for a moment at the end of the twist, then slowly rotate back to the starting position.
Repeat the twist to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在平坦的长凳上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲。
双手握住杠铃于胸前，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的躯干扭转到一侧，保持背部挺直。
扭转结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢旋转回到起始位置。
重复扭转到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0158.description: A decline cable fly for the lower chest.
instructions: Adjust the cable machine to a decline position.
Stand facing away from the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the handles with your palms facing forward and your arms extended straight out in front of you.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, open your arms out to the sides in a controlled motion.
Pause for a moment at the fully extended position, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将拉线机调整至下降位置。
背对机器站立，双脚与肩同宽。
握住手柄，手掌朝前，双臂在身前伸直。
保持肘部轻微弯曲，以受控的动作向两侧张开双臂。
在完全伸展位置停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0222.description: A standing cable side bend, lowering the handle toward the knee. It trains the obliques and the side of the waist.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and grasp the cable handle with one hand.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Slowly bend sideways at the waist, lowering the cable handle towards your knee.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Alternate sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，用一只手抓住电缆手柄。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
腰部慢慢向侧面弯曲，将电缆手柄向膝盖方向降低。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
交替进行所需的重复次数。

0286.description: A standing dumbbell shoulder press that alternates arms. One arm presses overhead while the other stays at the shoulder.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Press one dumbbell overhead while keeping the other dumbbell at shoulder height.
Lower the pressed dumbbell back to shoulder height while pressing the other dumbbell overhead.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，与肩同高。
将一个哑铃推过头顶，同时将另一个哑铃保持在与肩同高的位置。
将按下的哑铃放回肩部高度，同时将另一个哑铃压过头顶。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0350.description: You lie on a bench and curl dumbbells with palms up. The lying position keeps the biceps working under steady tension.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝上，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0414.description: Standing, you press dumbbells overhead one arm at a time. It builds the shoulders and triceps while the core stays braced.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Press one dumbbell overhead, fully extending your arm.
Lower the dumbbell back to shoulder level.
Repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，与肩同高，手掌朝前。
将一只哑铃举过头顶，完全伸展手臂。
将哑铃放低至肩部水平。
用另一只手臂重复上述步骤。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

0542.description: You swing a kettlebell from between your legs to overhead in one fluid motion with a single arm. A power exercise for hips, shoulders and back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand between your legs.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips, lowering the kettlebell towards the ground.
Explosively extend your hips and knees, using the momentum to swing the kettlebell up towards your shoulder.
As the kettlebell reaches shoulder height, rotate your hand and punch it straight up overhead, fully extending your arm.
Lower the kettlebell back down between your legs and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手将壶铃放在两腿之间。
稍微弯曲膝盖并铰接臀部，将壶铃降低到地面。
爆发性地伸展你的臀部和膝盖，利用动量将壶铃向上摆动到你的肩膀上。
当壶铃到达肩膀高度时，旋转你的手并将其直接击打到头顶，完全伸展你的手臂。
将壶铃放回到双腿之间，然后重复所需的重复次数。

0606.description: Chest on the pad, you row a T-bar style handle toward your torso. Works the lats, mid back and rear delts.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footplate position to ensure proper alignment.
Sit on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the footplate.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Pull the handles towards your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度和踏板位置以确保正确对齐。
坐在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在踏板上。
正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将手柄拉向躯干，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在收缩峰值时暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0670.description: A pull-up where you pull toward the back of your neck. Challenges the upper back and shoulders, so keep it controlled.
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 正手握住引体向上杆，握距略宽于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
收紧背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，保持肘部靠近身体。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0734.description: The wall sit, a hold that builds endurance in the thighs without any equipment.
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and walk your feet forward.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your back flat against the wall and your weight on your heels.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Hold for 20-60 seconds, then slide back up the wall to finish.

0798.description: Easy, steady pedaling on a stationary bike at a walking-like pace. It builds endurance and warms up the legs.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position on the stationary bike to ensure proper alignment.
Place your feet on the pedals and secure them with the straps if available.
Start pedaling at a comfortable pace, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Maintain a steady rhythm and increase the resistance level if desired.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration of your cardio workout.
Cool down by gradually reducing your pace and resistance level.
Stretch your leg muscles after the workout to prevent tightness and promote recovery.
instructionsZh: 调整固定自行车上的座椅高度和位置，以确保正确对齐。
将脚放在踏板上，并用带子（如果有）将其固定。
以舒适的速度开始踩踏，保持背部挺直，核心参与。
保持稳定的节奏，并根据需要增加阻力水平。
继续踩踏您的有氧运动所需的持续时间。
通过逐渐降低步速和阻力水平来冷静下来。
锻炼后伸展腿部肌肉，以防止紧绷并促进恢复。

0862.description: A cable twist that rotates the torso with a handle held at the chest. It trains the obliques and abs.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the cable machine.
Hold the cable handle with both hands in front of your chest, keeping your arms slightly bent.
Engage your core and slowly rotate your torso to one side, keeping your hips and legs stable.
Pause for a moment at the end of the rotation, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat the rotation to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，面向绳索机。
双手握住电缆手柄于胸前，保持双臂略微弯曲。
启动你的核心并慢慢地将你的躯干旋转到一侧，保持你的臀部和腿部稳定。
旋转结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
向另一侧重复旋转。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0926.description: A leg extension while standing with a band around the ankle. It works the quads.
instructions: Anchor the band behind you and loop it around one ankle.
Hold support and lift the knee slightly.
Straighten your knee forward.
Squeeze your quad.
Bend slowly to return, then switch legs.

0990.description: A seated one-arm row with a band and a torso twist. It trains the back and obliques.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold the band with one hand and extend your arm fully in front of you.
Keeping your back straight, pull the band towards your body by bending your elbow and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
At the same time, twist your torso towards the side of the pulling arm.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension in the band and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
用一只手握住弹力带，并将手臂完全伸到身前。
保持背部挺直，弯曲肘部并将肩胛骨挤压在一起，将弹力带拉向身体。
同时，将躯干向拉动手臂的一侧扭转。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢释放弹力带的张力并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。
